name: io.github.nhost/mcp
title: Nhost
description: Let your users work with their own data through an AI assistant, limited to what they can see.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: GraphQL endpoint of the Nhost project the server exposes, e.g. http://hasura-service:8080/v1/graphql

environmentVariables.name: MCP_STORAGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Storage URL for the same Nhost project, including /v1; enables file/image upload, download, replacement and deletion tools

environmentVariables.name: MCP_STORAGE_MAX_TRANSFER_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum decoded storage upload batch or storage response size in bytes; default 50000000 (50 MB)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_STORAGE_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum MCP POST body in bytes when storage is enabled, including base64 and metadata; default 70000000 (70 MB)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_URL
environmentVariables.description: Nhost Auth URL used as the OAuth2 authorization server, e.g. https://SUBDOMAIN.auth.REGION.nhost.run/v1
